title: Make obsolete Ghost Ship floor-tile cleanup retry-safe

phases.title: Always detect and remove obsolete Ghost Ship floor tiles before marking migration complete

finalChecks.name: Obsolete tile cleanup participates in repair gate
Tile deletion precedes version update
finalChecks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); const d=s.indexOf('deleteEmbeddedDocuments(\"Tile\"'); const u=s.indexOf('await target.update(update)'); if(d<0||u<0||d>u) throw new Error('obsolete tile deletion must happen before scene update');"

finalChecks.name: Manifest version
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.6') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.6');"
